scope: Factual review of 30 exact public model license chains. 29 permit commercial use with conditions; one restricts use to research/evaluation and requires a separate commercial license. This is not legal clearance, permission acquisition or beta approval.
review_method: Read immutable model-card declarations and publisher/base/ancestor documents retained by the audit; verify all locally retained document bytes against recorded SHA-256.
Read complete Apache, MIT, Qwen Research and Phi NOTICE texts; compare Apache variants (substantive terms identical; copyright/year and whitespace differ).
Review license-related card passages for scope/conflicts; corroborate linked Google Apache page and representative pinned licenses with live public browsing.
A quantizer declaration is evidence for its conversion, not authority to remove ancestor conditions. Different compatible permissive layers are retained together.

Retain only the complete Google license PRE block and its extracted text; the captured full response fingerprint remains recorded, while unrelated website scripts/client configuration are not distributed. Fragment extraction was verified against the captured response with exactly one PRE block.
